claim: Based on pinned KerML 1.0 and SysML 2.0, with bounded support. No full language, semantic-interchange or API conformance claim.
library_publication: Official 2026-04 corrective release; original OMG downloads preserved in standards/baseline-lock.json

status_meaning.supported_subset: Implemented within the stated boundary; never all forms of the named metaclass
status_meaning.partial: Some applicable structures or validation rules remain unimplemented
status_meaning.preserved_only: Original source survives; meaning is not interpreted

capabilities.boundary: Named packages, quoted names, public/private imports, wildcard imports, explicit definitions/usages, lexical resolution and typed feature chains in the self-model. Source recovery and diagnostics for other forms.
gaps: Full inherited-member lookup, alias/import visibility rules, all multiplicity and cross-metaclass constraints are not implemented.
The official library sources are indexed for declarations; their complete semantic graphs are not constructed or independently certified by Agentique.

capabilities.feature: Parts, item payloads, ports and connections
capabilities.boundary: Self-model part composition, item definitions, scalar item fields, ports, conjugated port usage and structural connect statements. Runtime only resolves a unit-multiplicity selected occurrence and receiver; it does not execute connected systems.
gaps: End memberships, reference subsettings, positional redefinitions and directly inherited typing are represented. Complete connector feature-chain and inherited-end validation remain incomplete.
General conjugated inherited ports and interface definitions are outside the implemented projection.

capabilities.boundary: Exact Integer, Boolean, String literals; bound scalar attributes and named payload fields; ==, !=; Integer < <= > >=; Boolean not, and, or, xor and symbolic & |. No arithmetic, Real coercion, arbitrary calls or assignments. 4096-digit Integer limit.
clauses: KerML expression semantics and official function libraries
gaps: The npm validator reports an unresolved named payload; the official pilot independently accepts this fixture with zero errors. Both outcomes are recorded; see docs/standards-discrepancies.md.

capabilities.boundary: AGQ-SEQ-01: one flat exclusive region, empty entry, immediately following initial succession, item-triggered transitions with optional pure guard and no effects. Selection and all scenario paths resolve to IDs before execution. Explicit executable inheritance/redefinitions are refused.
gaps: Compact relationship projections do not serialize every inherited relationship or feature-chain property. Private ElementReference edges are distinguished from normative ReferenceSubsetting; binding and succession ends are explicit.
No arbitrary actions, parallel or nested execution, timers, continuous equations, external effects or live agents.

capabilities.boundary: Documentary requirement definitions/usages, IDs, descriptions, verification definitions, subject typing, objective and verify references. External acceptance procedures are registered separately. Empty verification bodies always remain not_run.
gaps: No execution of SysML verification procedures, requirement predicates or satisfaction inference.

capabilities.boundary: View declaration names, ownership and base specialization can be represented. Console panels are application projections, not claims of standard RenderingUsage execution.
tests: Console lifecycle, source navigation, shared context and reviewed Assistant change
Keyboard inspection and recoverable source drafts
gaps: Standard view/rendering expression evaluation and full view metamodel validation are not implemented.

capabilities.boundary: UTF-8 .sysml/.kerml text and one-language .kpar ZIP projects with standard top-level project metadata, dependencies, checksum and index. Private identity sidecar is distinguished from standard text. Unsafe, unknown or stale identity content is refused.
gaps: No XMI/JSON abstract-syntax interchange, arbitrary project dependencies, range constraints or wrapped project imports; no full interchange conformance claim.

capabilities.boundary: Read mapping for local project/main branch/commits/elements/roots. Standard cursor names and Link pagination. Agentique operations in a separate namespace.
tests: API authentication, scope, identity mapping and revision checks
gaps: Element serialization is partial; official API conformance suite not executed. All unimplemented published operations are enumerated in api-coverage.json.
